- **Outpatient X-rays:** The row gives $50 in network and 20% out of network, with no setting named, so I used `any`.
- **Diagnostic radiology:** The in-network costs split by setting, so I stated one fact per cost:
  - A diagnostic mammogram is $0.
  - All other diagnostic radiology in an outpatient hospital is $500.
  - All other services in all other locations are $125. I did not map this to a specific setting, so I used `any` and added a note.
  - Out of network is 20%. The row names no setting, so I used `any`.
- **Not stated:** Every in-network diagnostic radiology cost is attached to the row "Diagnostic Radiology Services (e.g. MRI, CAT Scan)". The "all other diagnostic radiology services" cost in the outpatient hospital therefore covers the non-mammogram services in the row. I stated it as `imaging.diagnostic`, which matches the row, and noted that it excludes mammograms.
